PRINCIPLE: Tests should focus on a single requirement/behavior with a single Arrange-Act-Assert. RATIONALE: Single-focus simplifies root-cause analysis. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if exactly one method call/scenario and one AAA block. DECISION: The method performs multiple distinct 'Act' operations (multiple empilha()/desempilha() sequences and a try/catch covering two distinct outcomes) -> more than one tested operation. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests must not depend on execution order and should initialize state per test. RATIONALE: Ensures deterministic, parallelizable tests. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if uses only local variables or proper setup/teardown. DECISION: test1 uses only local variables (Pilha pilha0 created inside the method) and does not rely on static or shared state. No ordering indicators. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Provide at least a happy path and an error scenario, ideally in separate tests. RATIONALE: Ensures both expected and error behaviors are validated. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant requires at least two test methods covering success and failure. DECISION: Although this single test attempts to exercise both success and exception branches via try/catch, the class contains only one test method; the rule requires at least two separate test methods. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should include boundary inputs (empty, zero, null). RATIONALE: Boundaries often reveal off-by-one errors. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if test uses empty/zero/null/max/min or names indicate boundary testing. DECISION: The test explicitly pushes null and verifies size 0 after pops, and checks emptiness; it exercises a null input and zero-size condition. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should be self-contained with helper methods/constants to avoid duplication. RATIONALE: Reduces duplication and improves maintainability. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant when helper methods or constants are used. DECISION: The class contains no helper methods or constants; repeated sequences (stack setup/pops) are inline. VERDICT: non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should be short (<20 lines ideally) and avoid complex control flow. RATIONALE: Low complexity reduces test bugs. PRINCIPLE: Assertions should verify multiple properties to detect faults. RATIONALE: Superficial asserts miss bugs. EVALUATION CRITERIA: compliant if >=2 properties checked (size, content, order). DECISION: The test asserts size, emptiness, LIFO ordering, null content, and exception messages — multiple properties are verified. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should link to requirements (IDs/annotations) for traceability. RATIONALE: Facilitates impact analysis.
